content.value_statement: Teams need clear internal updates in consistent formats. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to draft newsletters, status updates, FAQs, and leadership messages.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 3P updates that organize progress, plans, and problems.
Supports company newsletters, FAQ responses, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.
Routes requests by communication type before drafting content.
Asks for clarification when the requested format is unclear.
Guides tone, formatting, and context gathering for internal communication drafts.
limitations: The referenced examples directory is not included in this package.
It does not send messages through email, chat, or intranet tools.
It depends on user-provided company context, audience, and facts.
It does not verify the accuracy of internal business updates.

use_cases.title: Draft Weekly Team Updates
use_cases.description: Managers can create 3P updates that summarize progress, plans, and problems for their teams.

use_cases.title: Prepare Company Newsletters
use_cases.description: Internal communications teams can turn announcements and milestones into a readable company-wide newsletter.

use_cases.title: Answer Employee Questions
use_cases.description: People teams can draft FAQ responses for policy changes, launches, incidents, or recurring employee questions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a 3P Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a weekly team update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a weekly 3P update for my team. Use these notes: progress [add notes], plans [add notes], problems [add notes]. Audience: [add audience].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Newsletter Item
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a company-wide announcement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company newsletter item about [topic]. Include the audience impact, key dates, owner, action needed, and a concise closing.

prompt_templates.title: Write FAQ Responses
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft FAQ answers for these employee questions: [add questions]. Use a clear, direct tone and include what changed, why, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Incident Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for sensitive internal communication.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these incident notes into an internal update: [add notes]. Separate confirmed facts, current impact, next update timing, owners, and employee guidance.

output_examples.input: Draft a 3P update from notes about launch progress, next sprint planning, and a blocked vendor approval.
output_examples.output: Progress: The launch checklist is nearly complete. Plans: The team will finalize sprint scope. Problems: Vendor approval is blocking release readiness.

output_examples.input: Create a company newsletter item about a new security training deadline.
output_examples.output: Security training is now open for all employees. Please complete the module by Friday. Managers will receive weekly completion reports.

output_examples.input: Answer employee questions about a delayed project rollout.
output_examples.output: The rollout is delayed to allow more testing. Current users are not affected. The project team will share a new timeline next week.

best_practices: Provide audience, purpose, deadline, owner, and source facts before drafting.
Mark uncertain facts clearly and ask reviewers to confirm them.
Match the format to the communication type before editing tone.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent business metrics, dates, or decisions.
Do not use it as final approval for sensitive employee communications.
Do not rely on unavailable example files for exact company templates.

faq.question: What communication types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, newsletters, FAQ responses, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Does this skill include company-specific templates?
faq.answer: No. The package references example files, but those files are not included in the scanned package.

faq.question: Can it send messages to employees?
faq.answer: No. It helps draft content only. Users must send approved messages through their normal tools.

faq.question: What should I provide for the best draft?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, goal, source facts, dates, owners, constraints, and the desired tone.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive announcements?
faq.answer: It can draft sensitive updates, but legal, HR, or leadership reviewers should approve final content.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
